moves.name: Thrust 1-2 (and Dash Thrust)
moves.desc: Forward thrust, hits 1 and 2 of the thrust chain (same record for both); also the Extreme dash forward thrust (action 75, motions 1483+1405) (MV 33)
moves.input: Thrust key (k199)

moves.name: Upswing
moves.desc: Rising slash after thrusts (also the base of the follow-up upthrusts) (MV 42)
moves.input: Upswing key (k214)

moves.name: Upthrusts (Earth/Heaven/Storm)
moves.desc: Same 30-MV upthrust hit as record 67 but a slower version (start delay 36 versus 10): the hand-written Earth/Heaven/Storm code spawns it, not the Extreme table (MV 30)
moves.input: Upthrust: guard, then Thrust key (k199) / after Upswing

moves.name: Thrust 3
moves.desc: Third forward thrust of the chain, one MV higher; the calculator lists 34 for Extreme and 33 for E/H/S, the wiki and the record say 34 for all (MV 34)
moves.input: Thrust key (k199), 3rd press

moves.name: Upthrusts (Extreme)
moves.desc: Quick upward thrusts (30 each); this record is the one the Extreme action table spawns (MV 30)
moves.input: Upthrust: guard, then Thrust key (k199) / after Upswing

moves.name: Rush Thrust (Unsheathe)
moves.desc: Step-in rising thrust from the drawn state (sigil raises 38 to 57; the wiki says 53); Extreme also uses it from a dash (MV 38)
moves.input: Thrust key (k199) from sheathed or after a dash

moves.name: Heat Blade burner hit, Thrust 1-2
moves.desc: The burner (fire head) of the Heat Blade / Elemental Blade: a 5-MV hit with fire that is spawned together with the blade hit it belongs to (Thrust 1-2; same start frame and active frames as the parent record 63). Records 124 and 127 both start at 20 / active 10 like thrusts 63 and 66: pairing follows id order (124-129 follow 63,64,65,66,67,70), not proven. (MV 5)
moves.input: (rides on Thrust 1-2 while the Heat Blade is lit)

moves.name: Heat Blade burner hit, Upswing
moves.desc: The burner (fire head) of the Heat Blade / Elemental Blade: a 5-MV hit with fire that is spawned together with the blade hit it belongs to (Upswing; same start frame and active frames as the parent record 64). (MV 5)

moves.name: Horizontal Sweep
moves.desc: Stepping sideways sweep (踏み込み薙ぎ払い) that opens the Full Burst; sigil raises 34 to 51; the Dash Sweep after a Bombardment Boost is record 254 (MV 34)
moves.input: Step-in sweep (踏み込み薙ぎ払い) after a thrust; its key is not named in the guide (pac_a1 lists it with the reload actions)

moves.name: Full Burst (Blade Slash)
moves.desc: Sword part of the Full Burst (連撃砲): blade MV 18 with the shells, for every shell type; Wycademy names it 'Backhop Slash (18 + Shelling)'. Six Extreme actions (three motions x two entries: after a sweep and after a dash sweep) (MV 18)
moves.input: Full Burst, after a Horizontal Sweep or Dash Sweep

moves.name: Elemental shell charge-up swing
moves.desc: Storm/Extreme: the swing before a horizontal elemental shell; has its own hitbox (25) when it connects (MV 25)
moves.input: Shelling key (k172) from a drawn, standing state

moves.name: Heat Blade burner hit, Horizontal Sweep
moves.desc: The burner (fire head) of the Heat Blade / Elemental Blade: a 5-MV hit with fire that is spawned together with the blade hit it belongs to (Horizontal Sweep; same start frame and active frames as the parent record 150). (MV 5)

moves.name: Heat Blade Slam (rotating slam)
moves.desc: Heat Blade / Elemental Blade finisher after thrust combos (回転叩きつけ); only guess: MV 85 here but the wiki and calculator say 62 for the slam. Its burner partner 210 has the same timing (start 50, active 12). The wiki and calculator also say the Dash Sweep (58) is the second highest, so 85 would make the slam the strongest (MV 85)
moves.input: finishing attack after thrusts while the Heat Blade is lit (key not named in the guide)

moves.name: Heat Blade burner hit, Heat Blade Slam
moves.desc: The burner (fire head) of the Heat Blade / Elemental Blade: a 5-MV hit with fire that is spawned together with the blade hit it belongs to (Heat Blade Slam; same start frame and active frames as the parent record 209). (MV 5)

moves.name: Dash Sweep (Bombardment Boost follow-up)
moves.desc: Extreme: sweep after a Bombardment Boost, the highest plain blade hit besides the Slam; not boosted by the Horizontal Sweep sigil (MV 58)
moves.input: Sweep after a Bombardment Boost (key not named in the guide)

moves.name: Elemental Blade burner hit, Dash Sweep (?)
moves.desc: Burner-type 5-MV hit with no fixed element in the record (the Extreme Elemental Blade takes the weapon's element), active for 22 frames from frame 0: nearest to the Dash Sweep record 254 (0 / 24), not an exact timing match (MV 5)
moves.input: (rides on the Dash Sweep while the Elemental Blade is lit)
